sizing_formulas.s1: 16 known committed/reserved original and resumed packets + 2 protected corrections + 2 bounded scope/accounting reconciliation packets

rules.duplicate_same_input: Reconcile original, do not dispatch again.
rules.uncertain: Retain full logical reservation; inspect original durable output/status. No automatic refund or retry.
rules.correction: New pre-reservation with predecessor and concrete defect; preserve original output and decisions.
rules.phase_accounting: Separately report preparation, initial construction, validation/judging, incremental update, routine reads and correction.
rules.within_session_repartition: Record before dispatch and keep the session total and protected correction balance; cannot release uncertain or already committed units. Changed case/source/interface requirements still need versioned review.
rules.cross_session_transfer: Requires a successor S1 allocation and affected-session acknowledgement; not permitted by this revision.
rules.exhaustion: BLOCKED before more inference; preserve exact pending operation. No hidden fallback or invented usage.
rules.ceilings: Worst-case capacities, never work targets. Do only needed affected work; reuse compatible accepted outputs with proof.
rules.review: Both persistent S5 judges; no replacement third vote.

gates: Exact scope/interface/source/recipe and authority for the packet must be resolved before dependent production.
Native route physical accounting stays UNKNOWN and AC-08 stays open; this allocation provides coordination, not physical enforcement.
Capture blockers hold their required closures, not unrelated preparations.
Public cases require S5 frozen concrete oracles before evaluation.
Product tests obey AGENTS.md; publication follows existing governed authority.

peer_corrections.resolution: S5 retains its bootstrap charges and two protected bootstrap corrections; supplemental review pools admit both first judge turns without borrowing corrections.

peer_corrections.observation: Latest pinned S3 handoff disclosed five preparation packets against bootstrap sizing of four preparation plus two protected correction packets.
peer_corrections.resolution: Preserve all five as preparation; do not rename the fifth correction or claim retroactive pre-reservation. Expanded capacity is prospective; the prior phase-sizing exception remains an explicit timing/control gap.

applicability: Replacement successor proposal. On exact canonical/recipient acceptance, it replaces the active 52-unit preparation envelope while preserving every reservation and uncertainty. It is never an additional parallel grant. The original scope, capture, authority, oracle and independent-review gates still apply.
